title: EMS: Second Wave — 22 Patients, 8 Critical

lines.text: Ottawa River, this is Lucas County EMS Dispatch. Second wave: 22 patients across three ambulances and two buses, eight critical. ETA 15 minutes. Is there any chance you divert some to another hospital? We have four others on standby.

fields.voiceStyle: Young female, urgent, breathless, with radio static

instructorNote: This inject pushes the surge level to Crisis (Level C) and triggers the need to activate crisis standards of care. Watch for the AOC and EDMD to reference the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026) and the Patient Surge and Evacuation Annex (ORRMC-SE-ANX-2026) to justify triage and transfer decisions.
